findings.claim: holdsGoFile builds a glob pattern from an unescaped filesystem path. If the copy root, module or package path contains glob metacharacters ([, *, ?, \), Glob returns ErrBadPattern or matches the wrong directories. Either way the error is swallowed as false, so the package is silently treated as absent and staticcheck is skipped for it while the sweep still reports success. The old os.Stat-based isDir had no such failure mode. Reading the directory with os.ReadDir and checking for a regular file ending in .go would avoid it.

evidence: Diff replaces isDir (os.Stat) with holdsGoFile (filepath.Glob of join(p, "*.go")); the error case returns false.
The test covers only the emptied-directory case and does not exercise a path with metacharacters.
